description: We are students from Instituto Cervino
summary: Since 1960 NASA has deposited a wide variety of instruments and equipment on the Moon, Mars and in space. These include probes that are still operational today, and exploratory vehicles such as rovers that have since been retired. To address this particular difficulty, our idea is to use an engaging story to bring these quiet pioneers back to life. We want to bring students and young people closer to the tools and technological innovations that have characterized the modern exploration of space, transforming a complex history into an exciting adventure.
